"''He'll know when I'm ready.|Timm Karlo and Bix Caleen|}} '''Jeef''' was an individual who wanted to know if [[Caleen Salyard]], a [[salvage yard]] on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]], was going to join in on a bid for a run to the planet''[[Rebel Rising]]'' [[Wobani]] in [[5 BBY]]. The [[Standard day|day]] before the bid, he contacted the yard to ask if they were in, so [[Timm Karlo]], a [[clerk]] working there,{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}} relayed the question to the yard's owner, [[Bix Caleen]]. Busy conversing with her friend [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], Caleen simply told Karlo that Jeef would know when she was ready. ==Behind the scenes== Jeef was mentioned in "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," the first episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Jeef |ja=ジーフ |ka=ჯიფი (ვობანი) |pl=Jeef }} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
